summary: Rotation and reuse detection are correct. The expiry check compares with the process clock instead of database time, against the phase pitfall.

findings.message: Expiry is checked with datetime.now() in RotationService.rotate.
findings.failure_scenario: On an API node whose clock runs 2 minutes behind, an expired refresh token is still rotated and a new token family member is issued.
findings.fix_hint: Select now() together with the token row and compare in the same transaction.

findings.message: _family_ids is a set but named like a list.

residual_risk: Concurrent rotation of the same token is covered by SELECT ... FOR UPDATE; not load-tested.
